title: `changes` of Thesis A's database tool, as handed to the checker (experiments/harness/dbtool/checker.py, 15 Nov 2026)
description: Thesis B's machine-readable reading of the docstring of checker.py: what one statement changed, in its state after the statement. The validator's write-time check reads exactly this. Thesis A owns the shape; this file is for tests and for the record. Additional fields are allowed everywhere.

realisation.description: schemas/treatments/<realisation>, e.g. S4-curated/pg; the checker loads its declaration.json

unit_id.description: added by the harness, never by the model

item_id.description: the agent's name for the fact (shared-minimum-log/1 item_id)

evidence.description: the passage the agent named; kept in the record, never a reason for a rejection

statement.description: the agent's Cypher or SPARQL, as run

from.description: element id of the start node; described under ends

ends.description: every node a listed relationship touches, created by the statement or there before: labels and properties
